# Schedule {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

The standing appointment

## A Standing Appointment {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="cron" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
Type **`/schedule`** in any Cowork task. *"Every Friday at 4pm, draft the weekly status."*
It just happens — you didn't have to ask.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
A schedule that **triggers the agent automatically** — with no human in the chat at that
moment.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; color: #666; font-size: 0.85em;"}
*(industry term: **Cron** — a standing scheduled job.)*
:::

# Guardrails First {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A5C, #1C355E)"}

Non-negotiable

## Draft / Notify-Me Before Act {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="guard" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.1em;"}
Every schedule and connector starts in **draft / notify-me mode** — it proposes, you approve.
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-important}
## Promote only after it proves itself
Move to **act-on-its-own** only once you've watched it get it right. Always ask:
*"What's the worst it could do — and who'd catch it in time?"*
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-style: italic; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
All hands-on work today stays **sandboxed**, on **read-only** or **draft-only** access.
:::

# Build: Your First Standing Job {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Notify-me mode

## Stand One Up {auto-animate=true}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Hands-on (sandboxed)
1. `/schedule` **one job** in **notify-me mode** — e.g. a daily inbox triage that
   **drafts** replies (never sends).
2. Connect **one read-only** data source.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
Log the **recurring time** it will save — then leave it in draft mode until you trust it.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-style: italic; margin-top: 0.3em;"}
**Refine:** check a neighbor's job for blast radius — *I like / I wish / I wonder.*
:::

# Micro-Check {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

Spot the unsafe automation

## Quiz {auto-animate=true}

Which scheduled job should **never** run in act-on-its-own mode on Day 1?

. . .

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**A)** Every morning, **summarize** my unread email into a note.

✅ Read-only. Low blast radius.
:::
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**B)** Every morning, **auto-reply** to all unread email.

❌ Irreversible, high blast radius. Draft-only.
:::
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-style: italic;"}
Ask: *what could it do if it's wrong, and who'd catch it?*
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **The autonomous leap** — from a tool you operate to a teammate that acts
2. **Schedule (`/schedule`) = a standing appointment** — the agent runs unattended
3. **Connectors = the keys** — Gmail / Calendar / Drive (MCP under the hood)
4. **Guardrails first** — always start in draft / notify-me mode
5. **Mind the blast radius** — promote to act-on-its-own only after it proves itself
:::
